elements.requirement: Where a company gives notice of a general meeting or a resolution intended to be moved at a general meeting, any accidental failure to give notice to one or more persons must be disregarded for the purpose of determining whether notice of the meeting or resolution is duly given.
elements.quote: any accidental failure to give notice to one or more persons shall be disregarded for the purpose of determining whether notice of the meeting or resolution (as the case may be) is duly given

elements.requirement: The rule that accidental failure to give notice is disregarded has effect subject to any provision of the company's articles, except in relation to notice given under section 304, section 305, or section 339.
elements.quote: subsection (1) has effect subject to any provision of the company's articles

elements.requirement: The company's articles cannot override the accidental notice rule in relation to notice given under section 304 (notice of meetings required by members), section 305 (notice of meetings called by members), or section 339 (notice of resolutions at AGMs proposed by members).
elements.quote: Except in relation to notice given under— (a) section 304 (notice of meetings required by members), (b) section 305 (notice of meetings called by members), or (c) section 339 (notice of resolutions at AGMs proposed by members)

thresholds.what: number of persons to whom an accidental failure to give notice may occur and be disregarded
